name: manual_8e0fe1
claim: When splitting a script that callers load by file path into a sibling package, bind the package from the script's real path with an explicit module spec, without reading or changing sys.path; do not re-export names that moved and that tests patch, so a stale patch fails loudly; and test load by path, a run from another directory and a symlinked skill directory. Script and package must be copied or linked together.
